newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hylsamex still seeking $190 mln in loans.
newsitem.headline: Hylsamex still seeking $190 mln in loans.

text.p: Mexican steel firm Hylsamex is still hoping to win $190 million in foreign loans and denied on Thursday that credits already had been received, a company official said.
Rafael Rubio, assistant director for economic studies for Hylsamex, denied local media reports the credits had been received.
"The two credits are still in process," Rubio told Reuters. "We'll have them at the end of June or beginning of July."
Hylsamex is negotiating an $80 million loan with Santander to be paid off over six years with a one-year grace period at a rate of Libor plus 1.5 percent.
In addition, the Monterrey-based company is seeking a $110 million loan with the Export-Import Banks of the United States, Canada, Germany and Italy. Terms have not been made available.
